subject: botany_2
question_text: Name any two fungi which are used in the production of antibiotics.

verification.note: Sourced from "Sr. Botany — My Baby Bullet-Q" (Sri Publishers, STAR-Q Pass Track), book p.49, printed question 148. Botany-II holds only ONE source book: the TSBIE Basic Learning Material in hand covers physics only, and no Telangana Botany-II board paper is in the corpus, so the two-book union check and the board back-test are BOTH structurally impossible for this card — "not checked" does NOT mean "checked and clean". Run both the moment a second source or a real paper arrives. The mark split is a claim until a Telangana IPE teacher confirms it. BOOK NOTE: the guide prints "Pencillium notatum" and "Pencillin griseoflavus". The correct names are PENICILLIUM NOTATUM and PENICILLIUM GRISEOFULVUM. Corrected here.

insider_note: Two fungi, two antibiotics. Watch the spelling: Penicillium is the fungus, penicillin is the drug.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Two fungi
steps.margin_note: Both names spelled correctly, plus the spelling note.
lines: Two fungi used to produce antibiotics:
Note the spelling: PenicilliUM is the fungus,
steps.why: Both are Penicillium species, which is why the fungus and the drug have such similar names and are so easily confused.
common_mistakes: Writing 'Pencillium'. It is PENICILLIUM, with an i after the P-e-n.
Naming Aspergillus niger. That produces CITRIC ACID, not an antibiotic.
steps.memory_tip: The fungus ends in -ium; the drug ends in -in.

steps.label: The antibiotic each gives
steps.margin_note: Both pairs, and one line on what griseofulvin treats.
lines: antibiotic, used against fungal infections of skin and nails.
steps.why: A fungus producing an antifungal antibiotic is not a contradiction: it is competing with other fungi for the same food.
common_mistakes: Matching the wrong drug to the wrong species. Notatum gives penicillin; griseofulvum gives griseofulvin.
Saying griseofulvin is antibacterial. It is ANTIFUNGAL.
steps.memory_tip: Each species is named after what it makes.
